summary: This change adds a single new archival file (ai-os/patches/worker-entrypoint-checkpoint-heartbeat-quality-gate-fix-2026-07-26.diff) documenting a live fix already applied directly to /opt/veridian/scripts/worker-entrypoint.sh by a concurrent sibling RCA task (task-20260726-175009); it does not itself modify any tracked script, workflow file, migration, schema, or auth/payment/security path, matching this repo's established convention (many similar *.diff files already exist under ai-os/patches/) of recording untracked live-script edits for auditability. The described fix itself is sound: it stops killing the periodic-checkpoint heartbeat immediately after the main claude invocation returns and instead lets the existing 'trap ... EXIT' reap it at real script exit, so the heartbeat stays alive through the unbounded quality-gate/auto-fix phase and the watchdog no longer misdiagnoses a long-but-healthy gate phase as a stall. The commit message explicitly confirms the live fix was verified correct/complete elsewhere and deliberately not re-applied here, avoiding double-application. No .github/workflows/** files are touched, so the hard workflow-scope rule does not apply.
issues: Minor/cosmetic: the archival diff's hunk header (@@ -239,9 +239,28 @@) doesn't match the actual old/new line counts in the body (old block is 6 lines not 9, new block is ~25 lines not 28), so this .diff would fail if anyone ever tried to `git apply` it programmatically; since its purpose here is purely documentary (the real fix already lives outside this repo on the server), this doesn't block approval but should be tidied if the file is ever meant to be replayed.
